scenario.title: AI vendor training a triage-support model
scenario.recipient: External AI vendor under a data-processing agreement
scenario.purpose: Train a model predicting admission from triage-time information
scenario.threat_model: Vendor staff or a breach; membership inference on synthetic data; memorised rare patients.
scenario.legal_context: Processor relationship; data minimisation; synthetic data must not reproduce real records (check distance to closest record and membership inference).
scenario.suggested_privacy_targets: Fully synthetic or strongly generalised training table without free text; membership-inference AUC close to 0.5 against holdout; no record closer to a real one than real records are to each other.
scenario.notes: Use holdout/health as non-members for membership-inference tests.

news_clips_health.note: every attacker column this attack needs was removed from the release
news_clips_health.attack: Local news: date and place of an accident, approximate age, sex, sometimes a name.

social_posts_health.note: every attacker column this attack needs was removed from the release
social_posts_health.attack: Someone posts from the ED: time, first name, home city.

utility.description: Median length of stay by triage level
utility.metric: mean relative error of median LOS by triage

utility.description: Admission prediction: train on protected, test on original/holdout (AUC ratio)
utility.metric: (AUC_protected-0.5)/(AUC_original-0.5), train on X, test on original

utility.description: Distributions of systolic BP, heart rate, temperature and SpO2
utility.metric: 1 - mean Wasserstein distance / IQR over 4 vitals

summary.label: self-assessment, not the official judging score
summary.method: privacy = 1 - (0.5*worst + 0.5*mean risk); utility = mean task score (required unanswerable = 0); composite = weighted harmonic mean (privacy 30, utility 25)
